metadata.title: rdzogs pa chen po rnying rgyud nang gsal sems klong sde gsum gyi phyi ma sin tu zab pa man nag rgyud kyi rgyal po/ the seventeen tantras of the rnin-ma-pa tradition which are the sources for the practice of the rdzogs-chen belonging to the man nag class
metadata.subject: rdzogs chen
description: Nyingma Gyubum. Collection the 17 tantras of the Nyingma. Reproduced from a set of blockprints carved under the patronage of the 1st king of the Bhutanese Dynasty, Urgyan Wangchuck by Jangchub Tsondru (1877-1916) at the monastery of Tarpa Ling. Original blocks are quite worn. Collection of 17 tantras of the instruction class (man ngag sde) of Atiyoga is based on the Bhutanese order seen in the Tsamdrak manuscript of the Nyingma Gyubum. Transmission of these tantras is usually given together. Besides the the Tarpa Ling blockprint, TBRC holds scanned images of the Sumra manuscript from Himachal Pradesh and tracings of the Adzom printing from Dudjom Rinpoche's library

Printed by hand from the xylograph blocks preserved at the thar-pa-glin monastery in bum-than in central bhutan; carved under the patronage of h.m. king ugyen wangchuck, the first monarch of the present dynasty
